text.tspan: EFG Holding has developed a comprehensive decarbonization roadmap as part of its long-term commitment to
sustainability and alignment with global climate goals. The plan sets out a series of proposed actions and strategic
initiatives designed to progressively reduce operational emissions as a start with financed emissions following
as ESG integration matures. It should be noted that they are preliminary in nature and will be subject to rigorous
research, detailed assessment, and comprehensive feasibility analysis to ensure their effectiveness, viability, and
These initiatives are underpinned by our robust and continuing ESG integration efforts and the strong
foundations laid among our employees on the importance of participation and individual responsibility
The findings of our carbon footprint assessment provide a clear view of
where our emissions occur and where action is most needed.
